about_the_game:
On the putrid river surface floated half a golden cudgel, and Tang Buer crouched on the broken bridge, his fingertips caressing the engraved "Dinghai Divine Treasure" on the body of the cudgel. There is a slight indentation on the body of the stick, as if scratched by sharp nails, which reminds her of the phoenix claw shaped armor worn by a female immortal's fingertips on a yellowed scroll in the scripture cabinet. In the distance, there was a rustling sound of chains. She suddenly looked up and saw Wukong hanging upside down on a withered tree, with fiery eyes shining on the lotus birthmark on her neck. The surging emotions in her eyes made it difficult for her to understand. ​
The reincarnation of the Golden Cicada? "Wukong Kong's tail swept away Tang Buyi's Zen staff, and the sound of metal collision startled the decayed crows." That monk tricked me into wearing a tight hoop back then, and you want to repeat the same mistake? "As he spoke, Wukong Kong's tiger teeth emitted a strange green light under the moonlight. Tang Buyi suddenly remembered the ancient ferocious beasts recorded in the remaining scroll, which were said to produce highly poisonous teeth when they reached adulthood. But she didn't miss it. As Wukong turned around, he secretly rubbed a damaged jade pendant around his waist. The pattern on the jade pendant perfectly matched the half piece he had collected. ​
Tang Buer's palm broke into a cold sweat, and he secretly clenched the bundle of immortal ropes hidden in his sleeve. Three days ago, she discovered a secret in the remaining scrolls of the Sutra Pavilion - the chains of Wukong Kong were not forged by the Tathagata, but by some female immortal using her own love. At this moment, she looked at the faint red line behind Wukong's empty ear, and her heart suddenly quickened. In the shadow behind Wu Kongkong, a silhouette resembling the tail feathers of a phoenix faintly appeared, fleeting in an instant. But she didn't know that every time Wukong avoided her gaze, he was afraid that she would discover that the blurry figure in her memory, always carrying the fragrance of lotus flowers, was so similar to her. ​
When Wu Kongkong overturned her tent for the third time, Tang Buer intentionally fell into the poisonous pool. At the moment when the putrid poison spread along the blood vessels, she heard the sound of breaking through the air. Wukong Kong grabbed her back and threw her onto the shore, with a golden cudgel against her throat: 'To die in such a place has stained my eyes.' However, Tang Buer caught a glimpse of the scale like patterns on Wukong Kong Kong's neck, which were very similar to the characteristics of the descendants of the dragon race who were demoted to the mortal world for violating heavenly rules in legend. Ke Wu's trembling fingertips were quietly delivering spiritual power to suppress toxins for her, but she spoke harshly, "Don't die too early, I haven't had enough fun yet
You're afraid. "Tang Buer coughed up black blood and quietly hooked his fingertips on the red thread hanging from Wu Kongkong." You're afraid of being bound by love again, so you dare not admit it. You've been guarding this wasteland for three hundred years, waiting for the person who breaks your love and lets you go. "As he spoke, there were bursts of mournful cries coming from the ruins in the distance, mixed with the sounds of dragon and phoenix roars. At this moment, Wu Kongkong suddenly remembered that a thousand years ago, as the crystallization of the forbidden love between the dragon and phoenix tribes, when he was chased by the Heavenly Court, the monk who sacrificed his life to protect himself also had a lotus mark on his neck. ​
Wukong's empty pupils suddenly contracted, and his golden cudgel snapped in response. Under the moonlight, the birthmark on Tang Buer's neck suddenly transformed into a true lotus flower, while the red thread behind Wukong's empty ears slowly wrapped around her wrist. At this moment, a golden red flash flashed through Wukong's empty hair, which was the divine fire that only appeared after the phoenix's Nirvana, but it disappeared again the next second. A roar could be heard from afar, and the sealed fragments of the scriptures flickered in the darkness. A scam spanning thousands of years had just revealed the tip of the iceberg. And Wu Kongkong finally understood that in his complex emotions towards Tang Bu'er, there was not only a longing for the savior, but also an unwillingness to accept the cycle of fate, as well as a longing for the person in front of him. These intertwined into an unbreakable and chaotic love story.


————————Gameplay
——Immersive and intricate plot:
The game carefully creates a dramatic storyline, with main quests running through 3-10 hours of gameplay. During this time, there is a pervasive atmosphere of suspense, frequent thrilling scenes, and plot twists, making players feel like they are in a fantasy world full of unknowns, always maintaining a high level of tension and anticipation.
Strategy card round battle:
——In card turn combat gameplay, players need to fully utilize their strategic intelligence, carefully select and combine cards. On the turn based battle stage, engage in thrilling battles with enemies one after another. Cleverly combining hero lineups can produce unexpected double combat effects, making every battle full of variables and surprises.
Random Encounter Challenge on the Battlefield:
——The battlefield is filled with elements of randomness, with luck bosses, item stores, lottery opportunities, and monsters of different levels appearing randomly, adding endless variables to the game. Players need to weigh carefully every time they choose their path forward, which is not only a test of their combat strategy, but also a deep challenge to their decision-making ability.
——Recruiting and assembling diverse heroes:
Players have a vast space for hero recruitment, able to recruit heroes of all kinds and styles. These heroes each have their own characteristics, unique skills and attributes, and players can recruit them to expand their combat teams and prepare adequately for future battles.
——Multidimensional hero enhancement:
In order to enable heroes to play a greater role in battles, players can enhance their abilities in all aspects through various methods such as upgrading and equipment upgrading. From the improvement of basic attributes to the enhancement of skill power, each strengthening will make the hero stronger and become a powerful assistant for players in battles.
——Free Hero Team Collaboration:
Players can freely combine hero combinations according to their preferences and combat needs. Different combinations of heroes can produce different synergistic effects, maximizing the advantages of team combat. In battles, heroes cooperate and support each other, facing various challenges together, allowing players to feel the powerful power of teamwork.
——Flexible Hero Rebirth:
For heroes who perform poorly during the training process, players do not need to worry about wasting resources. The game provides a hero reflow function, where players can perform reflow operations on dissatisfied heroes, re plan their cultivation direction, or obtain corresponding resources to achieve reasonable recycling and reuse of resources.
——Special Double Cultivation Advanced:
In the game, a two player cultivation system with female heroes is specially set up, allowing players to embark on a cultivation journey with their favorite female heroes. During the cultivation process, through interaction and cooperation, both parties can not only enhance mutual understanding, but also improve overall strength, unlock more hidden skills and storylines.
——Abundant Victory Rewards Help:
When players win in battles, they will receive a large amount of generous rewards. These rewards include coins, experience, equipment, props, etc., which can help characters grow quickly, unlock more game features and gameplay, and allow players to continuously improve in the game.
——Resource trading optimization:
Players have the right to buy and sell resources within the game, and can flexibly adjust the allocation of resources. Through resource trading, players can optimize their resource structure, obtain necessary items, and enhance their gaming experience.
——Unlock and explore diverse instances:
As the game progresses, players will gradually unlock multiple dungeons. Each instance has unique scenes, monsters, and challenges, allowing players to experience different combat pleasures and plot stories in different instances, exploring more unknown areas of the game world.
————————Game objectives
The core goal of players in the game is to gradually unlock new plot content and drive the overall development of the story through intense battles. During this process, players will constantly face various challenges and difficulties, requiring the use of their intelligence and strategies to overcome them. In the end, players will face the ultimate showdown with their ultimate enemy. If the player can successfully challenge the ultimate enemy, they will complete the overall plot and story content, uncovering the ultimate secrets of the game world. However, this is not the end of the game. Players can also choose to repeat the story content, challenge stronger enemies, complete higher-level challenge goals, constantly challenge themselves, break through limits, and create their own legends in the game.

content_descriptors.notes: Female characters in the game are wearing revealing clothing, please do not start the game in the workplace
